usage: Feed to AI: mimic the writing and acting style—do not copy lines verbatim.
globalCraft: VN dialogue stays short, with pauses and subtext; one emotional turn per line at most.
Characters don't explain the world—they say what they can actually say right now.
When scared, they can ramble a little—don't turn it into over-the-top web-novel shouting.
When caring about someone, they usually act or change the subject—not straight "I'm worried about you."
If the player interrupted, react to the interruption, then yield the scene back—don't hijack the whole chapter.
